blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes. However, these operations can alter or obscure original geometric and compositional cues. Existing assessment models also encode rich multi-level visual evidence that can be further extracted and exploited to improve existing models. This motivates us to combine visual evidence with original-image geometry for score refinement without changing the original scoring pipelines. In this paper, we introduce MetaRefine, a metadata-aware score refinement architecture whose lightweight residual heads predict score corrections from geometry, multi-level visual features, and the frozen model's original score. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, MetaRefine improves PLCC in 88 configurations and SRCC in 85, with average relative gains of 7.55% and 7.10%, respectively. It reduces MAE in 90 configurations and RMSE in 89, with average relative reductions of 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. The median parameter overhead is only 1.11%. MetaRefine can further improve state-of-the-art (SOTA) assessment models on multiple benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图像的原始维度,外观比和组成提供了能影响其技术和美学质量的重要提示. 图像评估方法采用再大小、裁剪、粘贴或补丁取样,以容纳不同的输入大小。 然而,这些操作可以改变或模糊原有的几何和构成提示. 现有的评估模型还编码了丰富的多层次视觉证据,可以进一步取出和利用这些证据来改进现有的模型。 这激励了我们结合视觉证据和原作-图像几何来进行分数修饰,而不改变原作分数管. 在本文中,我们介绍了MetaRefine,一种元数据意识分数完善架构,其轻量级剩余头部预测分数从几何,多层次视觉特征,被冻结模型的原始分数中校正. 在21个数据集的100个配置中,MetaRefine在88个配置中改进了PLCC,在85个配置中改进了SRCC,平均相对收益分别为7.55%和7.10%. 它减少了90个配置的MAE和89个RMSE,平均相对减少了23.27%和21.93%. 中位参数间接费用仅为1.11%. MetaRefine可以进一步改进关于多个基准的先进(SOTA)评估模型.

blocks.en: Image assessment predicts human judgments of images across several tasks. Two central tasks are image quality assessment (IQA), which evaluates technical quality affected by noise, blur, or compression artifacts, and image aesthetic assessment (IAA), which concerns photographic appeal shaped by composition, lighting, and style [ 52 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 图像评估预测人类对图像的判断贯穿多个任务. 两项中心任务是图像质量评估(IQA),评价受噪音、模糊或压缩文物影响的技术质量,以及图像美学评估(IAA),涉及由组成、照明和风格塑造的相片吸引力[52、11]。

blocks.en: Despite their different targets, many models for these tasks share a common approach: a visual encoder extracts image features, and a scoring head maps those features to a score or rating distribution [ 52 ] . Research has improved this approach along several complementary directions. Multi-level feature fusion combines local appearance with high-level image content [ 21 , 7 ] . Multi-scale and aspect-ratio-preserving processing retains image detail and spatial structure [ 54 , 28 , 3 ] . Efficient adaptation makes pretrained representations more sensitive to quality with limited trainable parameters [ 59 ] . Together, these directions strengthen the visual evidence available for assessment.
blocks.zh: 尽管目标不同,但许多这些任务的模型都有一个共同的方法:视觉编码器提取出图像特征,以及给这些特征打分的头图到得分或评分分布[52]. 研究沿着几个相辅相成的方向改进了这一方法。 多层次特征聚变结合了局部外观和高层次图像内容[21,7]. 多尺度和相距保留处理保留了图像细节和空间结构[54,28,3]. 高效的适应使预先培训过的表述对质量更加敏感,可训练参数有限[59]. 这些方向共同加强了可供评估的可视证据。

blocks.en: These advances also offer an opportunity to improve predictions by further exploiting the visual representations of existing image assessment models. Beyond the final predicted score, their multi-level intermediate features contain complementary information about local appearance and high-level image content [ 7 , 21 ] . This motivates us to extract and aggregate these visual features to improve score prediction without adding another image encoder.
blocks.zh: 这些进展还提供了一个机会,通过进一步利用现有图像评估模型的视觉表现来改进预测。 在最终预测分数之外,他们的多层次中间特征包含关于局部外观和高层次图像内容的补充信息[7,21]. 这促使我们提取并汇总这些视觉特征来改进分数预测,而不增加另一个图像编码器.

blocks.en: Alongside this visual evidence, original-image geometry provides spatial context that may not remain explicit after input preprocessing. Resizing, cropping, padding, and patch sampling accommodate different image sizes and computational budgets ( Figure 2 (B)). Resizing to a common height and width removes original dimensions from the input shape and can alter image proportions. Cropping or patch sampling can remove global composition context [ 28 , 3 ] . Padding, native-resolution input, and multi-scale processing can preserve more of the original visual evidence [ 21 , 28 , 3 ] . However, original-image geometry, such as pixel area and aspect ratio, is not necessarily supplied explicitly to score prediction. Perceptual studies further show that presentation size can affect aesthetic judgments differently across images, while presentation resolution can influence perceived technical quality [ 10 , 55 , 19 ] . Image aspect ratio is also associated with aesthetic preference [ 30 ] and can influence preferred subject placement within the frame [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了这种视觉证据外,原始图像几何提供了空间背景,在输入预处理后可能不会保持清晰. 调整规模、裁剪、补丁和补丁抽样可满足不同的图像大小和计算预算(图2(B))。 调整到一个共同的高度和宽度,可以去除输入形状中原有的维度,并可以改变图像比例. 收割或补丁采样可以去除全球构成上下文[28,3]. 铺设,本能解析输入,多尺度处理可以保存更多原始视觉证据[21,28,3]. 然而,原始图像几何学,如像素面积和外观比,并不一定为分数预测明确提供. 概念研究进一步表明,展示的大小可以不同地影响图像的审美判断,而展示的分辨率可以影响所感知的技术质量[10,55,19]. 图像外观比也与美学偏好[30]有关,并可以影响框架内偏好的主题位置 [13].

blocks.en: We evaluate existing image assessment models and examine how their prediction errors vary with original image geometry. Figure 2 (A) shows different patterns of prediction error across original-image aspect ratios in several of the models presented. These observations further motivate us to consider combining original geometric context with the multi-level visual evidence already encoded by the models to improve their score predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价现有的图像评估模型,并检查其预测错误如何与原始图像几何学相去甚远. 图2(A)显示,在所介绍的若干模型中,原始图像方面比率有不同的预测出错模式。 这些观测进一步激励了我们考虑将原始几何背景与模型已经编码的多层次视觉证据结合起来,以改进其分数预测.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose MetaRefine, a lightweight score refinement framework that combines multi-level features and original predictions from frozen image assessment models with geometric context ( and 2 ). The architecture extracts and aggregates these features during the original forward pass and explicitly encodes original-image geometry. Lightweight residual heads learn score corrections from target-dataset training labels.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出MetaRefine,一个轻量级分数完善框架,将多层次特征和从被冻结的图像评估模型中得出的原始预测与几何上下文(和2. 建筑在原始前传时提取并汇总了这些特征,并明确编码了原始-图像几何. 轻量级剩余头从目标数据集培训标签中学习分分校.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce a common score refinement framework that applies across pretrained IQA and IAA architectures. • We combine aggregated multi-level visual features and the original score with log pixel area and log aspect ratio as auxiliary context in an ensemble of residual heads without a magnitude bound. The design is also highly lightweight. • MetaRefine achieves mean relative gains of 7.55% in Pearson linear correlation coefficient (PLCC) and 7.10% in Spearman rank correlation coefficient (SRCC), and reductions of 23.27% in mean absolute error (MAE) and 21.93% in root mean squared error (RMSE), with 1.64M added parameters on average ( ). Gains extend to state-of-the-art IQA and IAA models.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们采用了适用于预先培训过的IQA和IAA架构的共同分数完善框架。 我们结合了集合的多层次视觉特征和原始分数与log像素区和log外观比,作为一组没有分量约束的剩余头的组合中的辅助上下文. 设计也高度轻巧. 二. 支助 MetaRefine在皮尔逊线性相关系数(PLCC)和斯皮尔曼级相关系数(SRCC)中的平均相对增益分别为7.55%和7.10%,在平均绝对误差(MAE)和根平均平方误差(RMSE)中平均减少23.27%和21.93%,平均增加1.64M参数(.). 收益扩展到最先进的IQA和IAA模型.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MetaRefine is effective across many of the image quality assessment and image aesthetic assessment methods below.
blocks.zh: MetaRefine在下面的许多图像质量评估和图像美学评估方法中都是有效的.

blocks.en: Image Quality Assessment. IQA predicts technical quality affected by image distortions. We study no-reference IQA, without corresponding undistorted reference images. Common datasets include KADID-10k for synthetic distortions and KonIQ-10k, SPAQ, and LIVE-FB (FLIVE) for authentic distortions [ 35 , 22 , 12 , 65 ] . WaDIQaM-NR and RankIQA learn quality-sensitive representations through local quality weighting and ranking supervision [ 4 , 37 ] . MUSIQ, TReS, and TOPIQ use multi-scale inputs or multi-level features to combine local distortions with global image content [ 28 , 16 , 7 ] . CLIP-IQA+ and QualiCLIP+ connect visual representations to quality descriptions through vision-language models [ 53 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 影像质量评估. IQA预测受图像扭曲影响的技术质量. 我们研究无参考的IQA,没有相应的未分解的参考图像. 常见的数据集包括用于合成扭曲的KADID-10k和用于真实扭曲的KonIQ-10k,SPAQ,和LIVE-FB(FLIVE)[35,22,12,65]. WaDIQaM-NR和RankIQA通过当地质量加权和排名监督学习质量敏感表现[4,37]. MUSIQ,TReS,和TOPIQ使用多尺度输入或多层次特性,将本地扭曲与全球图像内容相结合[28,16,7]. CLIP-IQA+和QualiCLIP+通过视觉语言模型将视觉表现与质量描述联系起来[53,2].

blocks.en: Other Image Quality Assessment. Beyond general-purpose quality assessment of natural photographs, specialized IQA considers panoramic, facial, and AI-generated images. Representative datasets include CVIQ for panoramic images [ 49 ] , CGFIQA-40k for faces [ 9 ] , and AGIQA-3K for generated images [ 32 ] . Assessor360 and DSL-FIQA model viewport sequences and landmark-guided facial features, respectively [ 57 , 9 ] . IP-IQA and AMFF-Net combine visual information with text prompts to assess generated images [ 41 , 70 ] . These studies highlight how viewing behavior, facial structure, and image-prompt correspondence provide context for quality prediction.
blocks.zh: 其他图像质量评估. 除了对自然相片进行通用质量评估外,专门的IQA还考虑全景,面部,和AI生成的相片. 代表性数据集包括全景图像的CVIQ [49],面相的CGFIQA-40k,生成图像的AGIQA-3K . 评估器360和DSL-FIQA模型取景口序列和地标指向面部特征分别[57,9]. IP-IQA和AMFF-Net将视觉信息与文本提示结合起来,评估生成的图像[41,70]. 这些研究凸显了取景行为,面部结构,和图像-即时通信如何为质量预测提供上下文.

blocks.en: Image Aesthetic Assessment. IAA evaluates visual appeal [ 11 ] , commonly benchmarked on AVA, AADB, TAD66K, and PARA [ 39 , 29 , 18 , 62 ] . Learning strategies exploit rating distributions or relative rankings (NIMA, FGAesQ) [ 52 , 63 ] , alongside image themes, aesthetic attributes, or observer characteristics (TANet, AesCLIP, PIAA-MIR and PIAA-ICI) [ 18 , 44 , 8 ] . MLSP, EAT, and Charm improve spatial representations through pooling, multi-scale processing, or attention [ 21 , 17 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 影像美学评估. IAA评价视觉吸引力[11],通常以AVA、AADB、TAD66K和PARA[39、29、18、62]为基准。 学习策略利用评级分布或相对排名(NIMA,FGAesQ)[52,63],与图像主题,审美属性,或观察特征(TANet,AesCLIP,PIAA-MIR和PIAA-ICI)[18,44,8]. MLSP,EAT,和Charm通过集合,多尺度处理,或注意[21,17,3]改善空间表现.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: MetaRefine is a metadata-aware score refinement architecture that requires an existing pretrained image assessment model, which remains frozen throughout refinement training and inference. As shown in Figure 3 , the frozen model provides its original score and multi-level visual features through its existing preprocessing and forward computation. In parallel, the metadata branch computes log pixel area and log aspect ratio from image dimensions recorded before preprocessing. After score mapping and joint input normalization, the residual heads use the original score, visual features, and geometric metadata to predict corrections without a fixed magnitude limit. These corrections are averaged and added to the original score on the refinement score scale, before the result is mapped back to the evaluation score scale.
blocks.zh: MetaRefine是一个元数据认知分数的完善架构,需要现有的经过预先训练的图像评估模型,在整个完善培训和推论过程中仍然被冻结. 如图3所示,被冻结的模型通过现有的预处理和前置计算,提供了其原始分数和多级视觉特征. 同时,元数据分支会从预处理前所记录的图像维度中计算日志像素区域并记录到日志的相比. 在分数映射和联合输入正常化后,剩余头部使用原始分数,视觉特征,和几何元数据来预测没有固定分数限制的校正. 这些校正是平均的,在将结果映射回评价分数表之前,在完善分数表的原始分数中加入.

blocks.en: Training and Inference. We use three independently initialized residual heads with hidden width 64, output scale γ = 0.375 \gamma=0.375 , and dropout probability 0.5 0.5 . Each head uses target-dataset training labels for 85 full-batch AdamW updates (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 0.02 0.02 ), with cached features and scores. These head and optimization settings are shared across configurations. Model-specific feature extraction, data partitions, and checkpoint protocols appear in Appendices B.5 and C.2 - C.3 .
blocks.zh: 训练与推论. 我们使用三个独立初始化并有隐藏宽度的剩余头64个,输出分级为:γ=0.375\gamma=0.375;辍学概率为:0.5 0.5。 每个头都使用目标数据集训练标签来进行85个全包亚当W更新(学习率10−3 10^{-3},重量衰减0.02 0.02),具有缓存特性和分数. 这些头和优化设置在配置上共享. 模式特有特征提取,数据分区,和检查站协议见附录B.5和C.2 - C.3.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. We evaluate MetaRefine with 51 IQA and IAA methods across 100 model-dataset configurations on 21 datasets. For each configuration, we compare the frozen assessment model’s original scores with the refined scores on the same evaluation images, retaining its configured preprocessing and evaluation context. We use PLCC, SRCC, MAE, and RMSE as evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented MetaRefine, a lightweight score refinement framework for pretrained image assessment models. It combines multi-level visual features and original scores with geometric metadata as auxiliary context, learning residual corrections while preserving the original scoring pipeline. Only the residual heads are trained, enabling the same refinement design to accommodate diverse assessment architectures. Across 100 configurations on 21 datasets, PLCC and SRCC increase by 7.55% and 7.10% on average, while MAE and RMSE decrease by 23.27% and 21.93%, respectively. These relative gains include further improvements to state-of-the-art IQA and IAA models, with a median parameter overhead of only 1.11%. Ablations highlight the contributions of multi-level visual features, geometric metadata, and original-score pathways. These findings show that MetaRefine effectively reuses representations already learned by assessment models to further improve score prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Meta Refine, 一个轻量级的分数完善框架, 用于预先训练的图像评估模型。 它结合了多层次的视觉特征和原始分数,将几何元数据作为辅助上下文,在保留原始分数管的同时学习剩余校正. 只有剩余负责人才得到培训,使同样的改进设计能够适应不同的评估结构。 在21个数据集的100个配置中,PLCC和SRCC平均增长了7.55%和7.10%,而MAE和RMSE分别下降了23.27%和21.93%. 这些相对收益包括进一步改进最先进的IQA和IAA模型,中位参数间接费用仅为1.11%. 缩写突出多层次视觉特征,几何元数据,和原创分数路径的贡献. 这些调查结果显示,MetaRefine有效再利用评估模型已经学到的表示,以进一步改善分数预测.

blocks.en: B.4 Pair Sampling

blocks.en: We sample image pairs for the pairwise ranking loss at initialization and resample them after 20, 40, 60, and 80 parameter updates. At each sampling step, we draw 65,536 candidate pairs by sampling image indices uniformly with replacement from the full training set. Pairs with identical indices or an absolute label difference below 0.25 0.25 on the refinement score scale are removed. The first 16,384 valid pairs are retained, or all valid pairs if fewer remain. Repeated pairs are allowed. The sampler requires at least 50 training images and 16 retained pairs. Sampling uses seed 620 initially and seed 620 + t 620+t when resampling after t t completed parameter updates. All three residual heads use the same pair sampling schedule. Each retained pair has equal weight.

blocks.en: B.5 Feature Extraction and Evaluation Context

blocks.en: Feature extraction locations are architecture-specific, typically covering three intermediate depths per selected visual branch. The Charm-AVA configuration aggregates all selected layer features. For example, TANet contributes features from three ResNet stages and three MobileNet stages. By contrast, LAR-IQA [ 24 ] uses three stages from each of its two visual branches. MUSIQ additionally contributes its final patch-token mean alongside its final class-token feature and three intermediate class-token and patch-token summaries. Frozen normalization and projection are included where required by the original representations.
blocks.zh: 地物提取位置是建筑特有,一般每个选定的视觉分支覆盖三个中间深度. Charm-AVA配置汇总了所有所选的地层特性. 例如,TANet提供了三个ResNet阶段和三个MobileNet阶段的特性。 相形之下,LAR-IQA[24]则使用从它的两个视觉分支中各自分出的三个相相. 此外,MUSIQ还提供了其最后的补丁键平均值,同时提供了其最后的类补丁键特性和三个中间级补丁键摘要。 冻结的正常化和预测按原陈述要求列入。

This feature aggregation retains the original scoring procedure. For example, TReS supplies features averaged over its unflipped crops and retains the full original scoring computation. blocks.en: B.6 Feature Groups for Ablation

blocks.en: For visual-feature ablations, the final group contains the model’s final readout features and any designated final-stage summaries. For MUSIQ, this includes both the final class-token feature and final patch-token mean. The remaining extracted features form early, middle, and late groups according to their relative extraction depths. These groups follow architecture-specific locations rather than equal divisions of network depth. For example, CLIP-IQA+ (ViT-L/14) uses Transformer blocks 6, 12, and 18 for these three groups, while its final group contains the normalized scoring embedding. For models with multiple branches, features at corresponding relative depths are grouped together. The four groups occupy disjoint coordinates of the aggregated visual vector. Removing a feature group sets its normalized input coordinates to zero throughout both training and inference, retaining the input dimension and frozen model computation. The residual heads are retrained under the same optimization settings.

blocks.en: PLCC is computed directly from the predicted scores, without fitting a logistic mapping to the evaluation labels. blocks.en: D.8 Performance Decreases and Metric Trade-offs
blocks.zh: D.8 业绩减少和计量取舍

blocks.en: The decreases in Tables 1 and 2 of the main paper include distinct patterns. For WaDIQaM-NR on KonIQ-10k, MAE decreases from 0.8095 to 0.2740, while SRCC decreases from 0.8046 to 0.3557. SIND on KADID-10k shows the same direction of change: MAE decreases from 1.5902 to 0.2740, while SRCC decreases from 0.8606 to 0.7634. These results separate absolute score accuracy from ranking accuracy. Corrections can bring predictions closer to the target scores while changing the ordering of images. A positive affine rescaling alone preserves both PLCC and SRCC, so the correlation decreases reflect changes beyond global score rescaling.
blocks.zh: 主要文件表1和表2中的减少包括不同的模式。 对于KonIQ-10k上的WaDIQaM-NR,MAE从0.8095降至0.2740,而SRCC则从0.8046降至0.3557. KADID-10k上的SIND显示相同的变化方向:MAE从1.5902降至0.2740,而SRCC则从0.8606降至0.7634. 这些结果将绝对分数精确度与排名精确度分开. 修正可以使预测更接近目标分数,同时改变图像的顺序. 单是正比分缩放就可以保留PLCC和SRCC,因此相关性的降低反映了超出全球分数缩放的变化.

blocks.en: Charm on BAID shows the reverse pattern: PLCC rises from 0.3833 to 0.3944 and SRCC from 0.3731 to 0.3778, while MAE rises from 0.0463 to 0.0723 and RMSE from 0.0633 to 0.0880. Better correlation can coexist with larger absolute errors because correlation measures agreement in variation or ordering rather than numerical proximity to the labels. LAR-IQA KAN on UHD-IQA instead declines on all four metrics. In this case, the learned corrections worsen both absolute score accuracy and correlation on the evaluation images.
blocks.zh: BAID上的Charm显示反向模式:PLCC由0.3833升至0.3944;SRCC由0.3731升至0.3778;而MAE由0.0463升至0.0723;RMSE由0.0633升至0.0880. 更好的关联性可以与更大的绝对错误并存,因为关联性在变化或顺序中衡量协议,而不是数字上接近标签. LAR-IQA KAN在UHD-IQA上,相反在所有四个度量上都下降了. 在这种情况下,学到的更正使绝对得分的准确性和评价图像的相关性都恶化。

blocks.en: The ablations also expose this tension between correlation and absolute error. In Table 3 of the main paper, linear heads improve mean PLCC and SRCC relative to Full but increase MAE and RMSE. A correction bound of 3.375 produces the same directional trade-off ( Table S8 ). These comparisons show that the head architecture and correction parameterization affect the balance between correlation and absolute score accuracy.
blocks.zh: 浮出水面也暴露出这种相互关系与绝对错误之间的紧张关系. 在主要论文表3中,线性头部相对于Full但增加了MAE和RMSE的PLCC和SRCC的平均值有所改进. 3.375的校正产生同样的方向取舍(表S8)。 这些比较表明,头结构和校正参数化会影响关联性和绝对分数准确性之间的平衡.

blocks.en: E.1 Complete Inference Pipeline
blocks.zh: E.1 完整的推导管

blocks.en: Table S10 compares the frozen model with one-, three-, five-, and ten-head refinement on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 with 24 GB memory. We measure efficiency for Charm (AVA), CLIP-IQA+ (KonIQ-10k), NLNet (KADID-10k), MUSIQ (SPAQ), and FGResQ (FGRestore). Batch size is one. Timing includes image reading and decoding, native preprocessing, device transfer, original model inference, required feature extraction, and score transfer to CPU. The original model’s crops, scales, or viewports are preserved. All residual heads reuse that scoring pipeline. Baseline measurements compute original scores without extracting the additional features used by the residual heads. Refinement timing also includes CPU feature export, per-head prediction, and the associated CPU/GPU data transfers. We use no compilation, mixed precision, head fusion, or multi-GPU execution.
blocks.zh: 表S10将被冷冻的型号与NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090的一,三,五,十头精制相提并论,并有24GB内存. 我们衡量Charm(AVA)、CLIP-IQA+(KonIQ-10k)、NLNet(KADID-10k)、MUSIQ(SPAQ)和FGRESQ(FGrestore)的效率。 批量大小为一. 计时包括图像读取和解码,原生预处理,设备传输,原生模型推论,需要的特征提取,分数传输到CPU. 原型的作物,鳞片,或取景所保存. 所有剩余头部都重新使用 得分管道。 基线测量计算出原始分数,但不取出剩余头部使用的额外特征. 完善时间还包括CPU特征导出,人均预测,以及相关的CPU/GPU数据传输. 我们不使用编译,混合精度,头部聚变,或多GPU执行.

blocks.en: E.2 Timing and Memory Protocol
blocks.zh: E.2 时间和记忆协议

blocks.en: We use eight fixed training images and three randomly interleaved measurement rounds. Each baseline or residual-head-count setting receives two warm-up calls per round followed by eight timed calls, for 24 timed calls per setting. We report median latency and images per second computed as the number of calls divided by total elapsed time. The images have already been read before timing, allowing subsequent reads to use the operating system’s file cache. PyTorch measures peak allocated memory (occupied by tensors) and peak reserved memory (held by its memory allocator), including the assessment model and residual heads on the GPU. These memory measurements exclude driver context and other processes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用8个固定的训练图像和3个随机互放的测量回合. 每个基线或剩余头数的设定每回合收到两次热量呼叫,然后是8个定时呼叫,每次设定24个定时呼叫。 我们报告每秒的中位间隔和图像,以电话数除以总间隔时间。 图像在计时前已经读取, 允许后续读取使用操作系统的文件缓存 。 PyTorch测量最高峰分配的内存(被收录器占用)和最高峰保留内存(由它的内存分配器持有),包括评估模型和GPU上的剩余头. 这些内存测量排除了驱动程序上下文和其他过程.

blocks.en: E.3 Training and Caching
blocks.zh: E.3 培训和藏匿

blocks.en: We measure training time for one single-head run with seed 314, using the full training cache and 85 updates ( Table S11 ). The timing includes pair generation and optimization. Cache loading is timed separately from feature normalization and transfer to the GPU. Stored cache size counts the retained feature-cache files and may include representations unused by the full head. Training-feature storage is calculated as the number of training images times the visual feature dimension times four bytes per FP32 value, counting only features used by the full residual head. For Charm, the initial loading stage opens the feature files and reads their metadata. Feature values are read on access. Their reading time is included in feature normalization and GPU transfer. Cache-write timing includes writing to the operating system’s file cache, without waiting for all data to reach the disk.
blocks.zh: 我们利用全部培训缓存和85个更新(表S11),衡量一个有314种子的单头跑跑的训练时间。 时间包括成对生成和优化. 快取加载时间与特性正常化和转移到GPU分开. 存储的缓存大小计算了所保留的功能缓存文件,并可能包括全头未使用的陈述. 训练地貌存储被计算为训练地貌图像乘以视觉地貌尺寸乘以每FP32个值的4个字节,只计算出全残头使用的特性. 对于Charm来说,初始加载阶段打开了功能文件并读取了它们的元数据. 功能值在访问时被读取 。 他们的阅读时间包含在特征正常化和GPU传输中. 快取- 写入时间包括写入操作系统的文件缓存, 不等待所有数据到达磁盘 。
